rationale: All four acceptance criteria are met. Both root causes (retry suppression and guaranteed FAILED transition) are addressed following the established MCPAuthenticationRequiredException pattern. The blind lens raised 'BadRequestError too broad' (ContextWindowExceededError/ContentPolicyViolationError are subclasses) — dismissed: those errors were also getting stuck before this fix (they hit default_retry_on and retried indefinitely), so the broader catch is an emergent benefit, not a regression. EC-002 (non-BadRequest exceptions still re-raise without fail()) is pre-existing behavior outside this ticket's scope. EC-003 (no MESSAGES_VARIABLE in return) matches the existing MCPAuthenticationRequiredException pattern verbatim and is correct. Test TC_BNL_BAD_REQUEST_001 asserts error_class but not error_message — minor deferred gap; production code is correct. Commit format, Ruff, and security checks all pass. 3 dismissed, 1 deferred (no patch/decision_needed items).

business_review.criterion: AC1: Workflow transitions to FAILED immediately on BadRequestError — no hang
business_review.evidence: BaseNode.__call__() detects LiteLLMBadRequestError (bare or wrapped in TaskException), calls workflow_execution_service.fail(), returns {NEXT_KEY: [END_NODE]} without re-raising. LangGraph receives a clean terminal state.

business_review.criterion: AC2: No wasteful retries for unrecoverable 400 payload errors
business_review.evidence: WorkflowRetryPolicy.custom_retry_on() returns False for LiteLLMBadRequestError both bare (TC_WRP_001) and wrapped in TaskException (TC_WRP_002). TaskException is unwrapped before the check, matching how the existing InvalidCredentialsError guard works.

business_review.criterion: AC3: User-visible error message comes from the original exception
business_review.evidence: Production code passes str(actual_exc) to fail(error_message=...) where actual_exc is the unwrapped LiteLLMBadRequestError — correct. Test TC_BNL_BAD_REQUEST_001 asserts error_class == 'BadRequestError' but has no assertion on error_message. Minor test coverage gap; production behaviour is correct.

The FAILED terminal state is reached deterministically through the new code path. workflow_execution_service.fail() is called before returning END_NODE, so the overall workflow status is set regardless of LangGraph's internal exception handling.

standards_review.notes: Both commits use 'EPMCDME-11918: <Description>' format per git-workflow.md. Branch name matches ticket ID.
Ruff check confirmed passing. Local import placement is consistent with existing patterns in the same method.
No auth, secrets, injection, or unsafe input handling changes in the diff.
No new source files created. Modified files retain existing Apache 2.0 headers.
